80200.commentary: (VINa) asaṃvihitā'ti saṃvidahanarahitā āgamanajānan'atthāya akatasaṃvidahitā, aviññātāva hutvā'ti attho. (PYt) asaṃvihitā'ti ettha akārassa virahatthaṃ dassento āha saṃvidahanavirahitā'ti.

examples.text: te ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhaṇḍanakārakā kalahakārakā vivādakārakā bhassakārakā saṅghe adhikaraṇakārakā asaṃvihitā taṃ āvāsaṃ āgacchanti, tehi, bhikkhave, āvāsikehi bhikkhūhi āsanaṃ paññapetabbaṃ

80201.meaning1: having distracted; having disturbed; having confused
80201.commentary: (VINa) tesaṃ vikkhitvā'ti kilantattha muhuttaṃ vissamathā'ti-ādinā nayena sammohaṃ katvā'ti attho. (PYt) sammohaṃ katvā'ti iminā vikkhitvā'ti padassa vikkhepaṃ katvā'ti atthaṃ dasseti.

examples.text: paccuggantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ, pānīyena paripucchitabbā, tesaṃ vikkhitvā nissīmaṃ gantvā pavāretabbaṃ, pavāretvā vattabbā, pavāritā kho mayaṃ, āvuso, yathāyasmantā maññanti tathā karontū'ti.

80202.meaning1: unable to stand scrutiny; unfit for examination
80202.commentary: (MNa) no anuyogakkhamo, no vimajjanakkhamo'ti anuyogaṃ vā vīmaṃsaṃ vā na khamati, thuse koṭṭetvā taṇḍulapariyesanaṃ viya kadaliyaṃ sāragavesanaṃ viya ca rittako tucchako'va hoti.

examples.text: tehi ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhūhi pavāriyamāne gilāno gilānassa pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapeti, so evam'assa vacanīyo, āyasmantā kho gilānā. gilāno ca ananuyogakkhamo vutto bhagavatā.

80203.meaning1: agreement about (the postponement of) the invitation ceremony

examples.text: evaṃ mayaṃ imamhā phāsuvihārā paribāhirā bhavissāmā'ti, anujānāmi, bhikkhave, tehi bhikkhūhi pavāraṇāsaṅgahaṃ kātuṃ.
pavārentā paṇāmañ'ca, kammaṃ gilānañātakā, rājā corā ca dhuttā ca, bhikkhupaccatthikā tathā.
āvāsikā cātuddasa, liṅgasaṃvāsakā ubho, gantabbaṃ na nisinnāya, chandadānapavāraṇā.

80206.notes: Originally a member of the Dravidian people living in southern India.

examples.text: savarehi khepitā megho, antarā ca pavāraṇā, na icchanti puramhākaṃ, aṭṭhapitā ca bhikkhuno.
cammakkhandhako pañcamo.
soṇakoḷivisavatthu niṭṭhitaṃ.
tena kho pana samayena rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro asītiyā gāmasahassesu issariy'ādhipaccaṃ rajjaṃ kāreti.
hitvā gāmasahassāni, paripuṇṇāni soḷasa, koṭṭh'āgārāni phītāni, sannidhiṃ dāni kubbasi.

80211.meaning1: wishing to see; wanting to look at

examples.text: atha kho soṇassa koḷivisassa mātāpitaro soṇaṃ koḷivisaṃ etadavocuṃ, rājā te, tāta soṇa, pāde dakkhitu'kāmo. mā kho tvaṃ, tāta soṇa, yena rājā tena pāde abhippasāreyyāsi.

80212.synonym: anusiṭṭha, ovadita, desita, viññāpita, sandassita, sikkhāpita

examples.text: tumhe khv'attha, bhaṇe, mayā diṭṭhadhammike atthe anusāsitā, gacchatha, taṃ bhagavantaṃ payirupāsatha, so no bhagavā samparāyike atthe anusāsissatī'ti.

80213.synonym: dhūpāyati, dhūmāyati, dhūmeti, sandhūpeti, sandhūmāyati, sandhūmeti, saṃdhūmāyati, saṃdhūmeti

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma phālo divasaṃsantatto udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati padhūpāyati sampadhūpāyati, evam'eva so guḷo udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati padhūpāyati sampadhūpāyati.

80214.meaning1: soon after ordaining; not long after being ordained as a monastic

examples.text: alattha kho soṇo koḷiviso bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, alattha upasampadaṃ. acir'upasampanno ca pan'āyasmā soṇo sītavane viharati.

80215.meaning1: balance of energy; evenness of effort
80215.commentary: (VINa) vīriyasamataṃ adhiṭṭhahā'ti vīriyasampayuttasamataṃ adhiṭṭhāhi, vīriyaṃ samathena yojehī'ti attho.

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā soṇo aparena samayena vīriyasamataṃ adhiṭṭhāsi, indriyānañ'ca samataṃ paṭivijjhi, tattha ca nimittaṃ aggahesi.

80216.meaning1: who has worn away the bonds of being; who has exhausted the fetter of existence; epithet of an arahant

examples.text: yo so, bhante, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇ'āsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano samma'd'aññā vimutto, so chaṭṭhānāni adhimutto hoti, nekkhamm'ādhimutto hoti

80218.meaning1: something more to be done within oneself

examples.text: khīṇ'āsavo, bhante, bhikkhu, vusitavā, katakaraṇīyo, karaṇīyam'attānaṃ asamanupassanto katassa vā paṭicayaṃ khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā nekkhamm'ādhimutto hoti
iṭṭhā dhammā aniṭṭhā ca, na pavedhenti tādino, ṭhitaṃ cittaṃ vippamuttaṃ, vayañ'c'ass'ānupassatī'ti.

80220.meaning1: prohibition against sandals with double-layered soles, etc.

examples.text: diguṇ'ādi-upāhana-paṭikkhepo niṭṭhito.

80221.commentary: (VINa) asītisakaṭavāhe'ti ettha dve sakaṭabhārā eko vāho'ti veditabbo. (PYt) asītisakaṭavāhe'ti ettha asīti padaṃ sakaṭapadena sambandhaṃ katvā asītisakaṭehi vahitabbeti attho daṭṭhabbo. dve sakaṭabhārā eko vāho'ti iminā vāhānaṃ cattālīsabhāvaṃ dasseti.

examples.text: ath'āhaṃ bhante ekapalāsikaṃ ce upāhanaṃ pariharissāmi, tassa me bhavissanti vattāro soṇo koḷiviso asītisakaṭavāhe hiraññaṃ ohāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito, sattahatthikañ'ca anīkaṃ.

80222.meaning1: son of a formerly good family
80222.commentary: (VINa) purāṇakulaputto'ti purāṇassa anukkamena pārijuññaṃ pattassa kulassa putto. mātipakkhapitipakkhato kolaññā khīṇā vinaṭṭhā matā assā'ti khīṇakolañño.

examples.text: atha kho so purāṇakulaputto khīṇakolañño āyasmatā upālinā anuyuñjiyamāno etam'atthaṃ ārocesi. āyasmā upāli bhikkhūnaṃ etam'atthaṃ ārocesi.
tiracchānagatavatthusmiṃ nāgamāṇavikāya'pi supaṇṇamāṇavikāya'pi kinnariyā'pi gāviyā'pi dukkaṭam'eva.

80224.meaning1: not progressed in the teaching; (or) not having the nature to develop

examples.text: atha kho so nāgo aviruḷhidhammo kir'āhaṃ imasmiṃ dhammavinaye'ti dukkhī dummano assūni pavattayamāno vissaraṃ katvā pakkāmi.
abhirattāni nīlāni, paṇḍūni patitāni ca, passanto tarupaṇṇāni, niccasaññaṃ panūdati.

80227.meaning1: one for another; one to another

examples.text: na paro paraṃ nikubbetha, n'ātimaññetha katthaci naṃ kañci, byārosanā paṭīghasaññā, na-aññam'aññassa dukkham'iccheyya.

80228.commentary: (ITIa) sāgāresū'ti sāgārehi, nissakke idaṃ bhummavacanaṃ, sāgārānaṃ vā santike.

examples.text: sāgāresu ca cīvaraṃ, paccayaṃ sayan'āsanaṃ, anagārā paṭicchanti, parissayavinodanaṃ.

80229.commentary: (JAa) kim'attham'abhisandhāyā'ti kiṃ nu kho kāraṇaṃ paṭicca kiṃ sampassamāno.

examples.text: kim'attham'abhisandhāya, lahucittassa dubbhino, sabbakāmadadass'eva, imaṃ dukkhaṃ titikkhasi.

80230.meaning1: to generate; to produce; to give rise (to)

80231.meaning1: to accomplish; to succeed (in); to successfully complete

examples.text: so ahaṃ idha vasanto pabbajitakiccaṃ nipphādetuṃ sakkhissāmī'ti cintesi.

80233.commentary: (SNt) tassa niggaṇhanan'ti tassa uddhatassa cittassa samādhi-sambojjh'aṅg'ādi-samuṭṭhāpanena uddhatāpattito nisedhanaṃ.

examples.text: samaye cittassa niggaṇhanatā'ti yasmiṃ samaye accāraddhavīriyat'ādīhi uddhataṃ cittaṃ hoti, tasmiṃ samaye passaddhi-samādhi-upekkhā-sambojjh'aṅga-samuṭṭhāpanena tassa niggaṇhanaṃ.
santappatī'ti ayaṃ kāyo santappati ek'āhika-jar'ādi-bhāvena usumajāto hoti. yena ca jīrīyatī'ti yena ayaṃ kāyo jarīyati. indriyavekallataṃ balakkhayaṃ valittacapalit'ādiñ'ca pāpuṇāti.

80235.meaning1: to teach; to educate; to instruct

examples.text: te c'ev'aññe ca bahavo, sissā maṃ parivārayuṃ, sāsituñ'ca samattho'haṃ, tato maṃ isisattamo.

80236.commentary: (SNt) vijaṭetuṃ ko samattho'ti iminā vijaṭaye'ti padaṃ satti-atthaṃ, na vidhi-atthan'ti dasseti.

examples.text: ko imaṃ vijaṭaye jaṭan'ti imaṃ evaṃ tedhātukaṃ jaṭetvā ṭhitaṃ jaṭaṃ ko vijaṭeyya, vijaṭetuṃ ko samattho'ti pucchati.

80237.grammar: abs of caus of √jaṭ, caus, trans (+acc)

80237.commentary: (SNt) tīsu dhātūsu ekam'pi asesetvā saṃsibbanena tedhātukaṃ jaṭetvā ṭhitaṃ. ten'assā mahāvisayataṃ vijaṭanassa ca sudukkarabhāvam'āha.

examples.text: ko imaṃ vijaṭaye jaṭan'ti imaṃ evaṃ tedhātukaṃ jaṭetvā ṭhitaṃ jaṭaṃ ko vijaṭeyya, vijaṭetuṃ ko samattho'ti pucchati.

80238.meaning1: related to the three realms of existence

examples.text: puññaṃ vuccati yaṃ kiñci tedhātukaṃ kusal'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ, apuññaṃ vuccati sabbaṃ akusalaṃ.

80241.commentary: (VINa) ekapalāsikan'ti ekapaṭalaṃ. (PYt) ekapalāsikan'ti ettha palāsasaddo paṇṇavācako. paṭalaṃ nāma paṇṇaṃ viya hoti, tasmā ekapaṭalan'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: ath'āhaṃ bhante ekapalāsikaṃ ce upāhanaṃ pariharissāmi, tassa me bhavissanti vattāro soṇo koḷiviso asītisakaṭavāhe hiraññaṃ ohāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito, sattahatthikañ'ca anīkaṃ.

80242.commentary: (VINa) sattahatthikañ'ca anīkan'ti ettha cha hatthiniyo eko ca hatthī'ti idam'ekaṃ anīkaṃ. (PYt) sattahatthikañ'ca anīkan'ti ettha anīkassa sarūpaṃ dassento āha cha hatthiniyo cā'ti-ādi. sattannaṃ hatthīnaṃ samūho sattahatthikaṃ.

examples.text: ath'āhaṃ bhante ekapalāsikaṃ ce upāhanaṃ pariharissāmi, tassa me bhavissanti vattāro soṇo koḷiviso asītisakaṭavāhe hiraññaṃ ohāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito, sattahatthikañ'ca anīkaṃ.

80243.meaning1: having elephants; consisting of so many elephants
80243.commentary: (VINa) sattahatthikañ'ca anīkan'ti ettha cha hatthiniyo eko ca hatthī'ti idam'ekaṃ anīkaṃ.

examples.text: ath'āhaṃ bhante ekapalāsikaṃ ce upāhanaṃ pariharissāmi, tassa me bhavissanti vattāro soṇo koḷiviso asītisakaṭavāhe hiraññaṃ ohāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito, sattahatthikañ'ca anīkaṃ.

80244.meaning1: with a storehouse filled (with); with a granary full (of)
80244.commentary: (DNt) koṭṭhaṃ vuccati dhaññaṭṭhapanaṭṭhānaṃ, tadeva agāraṃ tathā. ten'āha dhaññena paripuṇṇakoṭṭh'āgāro'ti. evaṃ sāragabbhaṃ koso, dhaññaṭṭhapanaṭṭhānaṃ koṭṭhāgāran'ti dassetvā idāni tato aññathā'pi taṃ dassetuṃ atha vā'ti-ādi vuttaṃ.

examples.text: paripuṇṇakosakoṭṭh'āgāro'ti koso vuccati bhaṇḍ'āgāraṃ, nidahitvā ṭhapitena dhanena paripuṇṇakoso, dhaññena paripuṇṇakoṭṭh'āgāro cā'ti attho.

80245.meaning1: moral perfection; quality of a sage

examples.text: tīṇi moneyyāni, kāyamoneyyaṃ, vacīmoneyyaṃ, manomoneyyaṃ.
na juhe na jape mante, aggihuttaṃ pahāpitaṃ, ko nu me pāricariyāya, pubbe cittaṃ palobhayi.

ayaṃ attabhāvo nāma tīhi aṭṭhisatehi ussāpito, navahi nhārusatehi ābaddho, navahi maṃsapesisatehi anulitto, allacammena pariyonaddho, chavirāgena paṭicchanno, navahi vaṇamukhehi navanavutilomakūpasahassehi ca asuci paggharati

80248.meaning1: relinquishing; releasing; letting go; giving up

examples.text: ahirikan'ti yaṃ na hirīyati hirīyitabbenā'ti (dha. sa. 1328) evaṃ vitthāritā nillajjatā. anottappan'ti yaṃ na ottappati ottappitabbenā'ti (dha. sa. 1329) evaṃ vitthārito abhāyanaka-ākāro.

mudhā'ti abyayena kākaṇikamattam'pi byayaṃ akatvā.

80256.commentary: (APAa) devānaṃ devo devadevo, taṃ devadevaṃ disvāna tassa lakkhaṇaṃ dvattiṃsa-mahāpurisalakkhaṇa-sañjānana-kāraṇaṃ. buddho nu kho na vā buddho'ti upadhārayiṃ vicāresiṃ.

examples.text: disvān'āhaṃ devadevaṃ, lakkhaṇaṃ upadhārayiṃ, buddho nu kho na vā buddho, handa passāmi cakkhumaṃ.

80257.meaning1: naturally occurring mental state; mind without intention

examples.text: vipassī-ādayo pana sabbe'pi bodhisattā mettāpubbabhāgena somanassasahagata-ñāṇasampayutta-asaṅkhārikacittena mātukucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gaṇhiṃsu. tena cittena gahitāya paṭisandhiyā asaṅkhyeyyaṃ āyu, iti sabbe buddhā asaṅkhyeyy'āyukā.
